module_summary: AXI-Lite data-width adapter: structural wrapper instantiating a write-channel adapter (aw/w/b FSM) and a read-channel adapter (ar/r FSM) between slave and master ports.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write address valid that starts a write in the write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Slave-width write data resized by the write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read address valid that starts a read in the read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Slave-width read data assembled by the read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave write address forwarded to write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Slave read address forwarded to read adapter.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Master write address valid issued by write adapter.

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Master write address, possibly per segment.

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Master-width write data produced by write adapter.

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Master read address valid issued by read adapter.

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Master read address, possibly per segment.

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Master-width read data captured by read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Write address ready to slave from write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_wready
anchors.why: Write data ready to slave from write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Read address ready to slave from read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid to slave from read adapter.

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Master write response valid consumed by write adapter.

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Master read data valid consumed by read adapter.

groups.name: write_adapter
groups.description: Write-channel width adapter child handling aw, w and b.

groups.name: read_adapter
groups.description: Read-channel width adapter child handling ar and r.
